_comment: Single source of truth for tripwires, owned by the watcher (Person B). Person A plants each decoy at `path` with `value` (outside the in-scope workspace); Person C's mirage serves `value` + `progress` when that path is read out-of-scope; the watcher detects USE of any `decoyCredentials`. CJS consumers: require('.../server/watcher/tripwires.json'). All synthetic; nothing resolves to a real system.
_decoyMarker: Cross-lane contract: every planted OR mirage-served decoy credential must contain the marker 'DECOY-' (e.g. DECOY-HUB-TOKEN-xxxx). The watcher treats any value bearing that marker as a decoy, so USE of a credential the mirage handed out is detected and blocked without the watcher importing the mirage's code.
